show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A rich Jewellery heir is cheated by his lover and reduced to a beggar. After helping a hungry saint, he receives a magical bowl that can double anything placed inside it. Using it, he regains wealth, wins back his showroom, finds true love, and punishes the betrayers. But when greed turns deadly, the bowl destroys the wrongdoers and teaches him that a second chance matters more than endless money.
